## Scope

Describe the mathematical, computational, or editorial change.

## Evidence boundary

- [ ] Symbolic claim proved or cited
- [ ] Exact finite computation accompanied by reproducible evidence
- [ ] Open/conjectural statements clearly labelled
- [ ] No superseded result promoted as current frontier

## Verification

- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] `ruff check src tests`
- [ ] `rgphi verify`
- [ ] Paper compiled if manuscript files changed
